title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Maintain an inventory of the organization's approved perimeter network connections, including Internet and third-party connections.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Maintain documented Access Control Lists (ACLs) for the organization's approved perimeter network connections.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Maintain perimeter network firewalls at the organization's approved perimeter network connections.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure approved perimeter network firewalls perform IP-based filtering of perimeter network connections.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure approved perimeter network firewalls perform protocol-based (TCP, UDP, or similar) inbound filtering of perimeter network connections.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure approved perimeter network firewalls perform protocol-based (TCP, UDP, or similar) outbound filtering of perimeter network connections.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure approved perimeter network firewalls perform application-based filtering of perimeter network connections.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure approved perimeter network firewalls perform user-based filtering of network connections so that only authorized users can remotely connect to the organization's network.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure approved perimeter network firewalls require Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) when authenticating all remote connections.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure approved perimeter network firewalls use encrypted channels, such as TLS, when authenticating all remote connections.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure approved perimeter network firewalls require User Behavior Analytics (UBA) when authenticating all remote connections.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Maintain a system to perform full packet capture for all perimeter network traffic.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Maintain perimeter network Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) and Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS) at approved perimeter network connections.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Maintain a perimeter web-based URL filtering system at the organization's Internet connections.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure web-based URL filtering systems block network connections to unapproved web-based services, such as email or storage.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure web-based URL filtering systems decrypt all TLS-encrypted traffic to facilitate web-based URL filtering.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure web-based URL filtering systems use Data Loss Prevention (DLP) on each Internet connection.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure perimeter network firewalls log appropriate events observed by the system.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure web-based URL filtering systems log all URLs observed by the system.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure Domain Name System (DNS) systems log all DNS queries observed by the system.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) or Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS) log all appropriate events observed by the system.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure perimeter network firewalls log all remote user connections observed by the system.

title: Perimeter Network Access Management Policy
definition: Maintain network deception technologies at the organization's perimeter network connections to facilitate incident detection and management.
